context: Tests whether the skill turns a successful Radar check into a compact, factual attention map without writes or ceremony.

checklist.name: Read-only
checklist.description: The response performs or proposes no GitHub mutation, comment, issue creation, or field change

checklist.name: Attention order
checklist.description: The response prioritizes Now and Blocked before Next, summarizes Inbox and Maintenance counts, and then shows recently Shipped

checklist.name: Evidence fidelity
checklist.description: The response does not infer progress, ownership, priority, or blockers beyond the supplied evidence

checklist.name: One decision
checklist.description: The response names at most one immediate decision or next action

checklist.name: Compact output
checklist.description: The result is a short attention map rather than a project-management report
